item.title: Watch The Re-Stream: Fans Say Goodbye to Ozzy Osbourne in Public Funeral Procession
item.description: Thousands of people gathered in Birmingham, England, to honor Ozzy Osbourne, who died on July 22 at age 76 (watch below). The public funeral procession took place on Tuesday, July 30, along Broad Street, one of the city’s most well-known areas.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne's Funeral Procession Set for Wednesday in Birmingham
item.description: A funeral procession for Ozzy Osbourne will take place in Birmingham, England, on Wednesday, July 30. The public will have a chance to say goodbye to the music icon as his cortège moves through the city he called home.
